subject: Post-call: Implementation plan + triage for intermittent 5xx during SDK integration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Chan <paul.chan@windward.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Implementation plan and next steps (SDK, auth, routing, rerankers)

Hi Paul — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we keep momentum on the POC: 

Recap
- Goal: Productionize a Redwood inference flow for Windward's document reranking pipeline (embedding -> candidate retrieval -> reranker structured-call).
- Primary integration surface: Redwood JS SDK (server-side), server will call /v1/chat with structured_call + embeddings for reranker.
- Constraints: low-latency 150–300ms p50, strict auth via Windward's API gateway (mTLS planned later).

Immediate action items (owner — due):
1) SDK auth check & sample curl (Paul) — share failing request dumps — due Wed 2027-06-02.
2) Increase client timeout to 60s during troubleshooting (Windward engineering) — due Tue 2027-06-01.
3) Redwood: provide routing and model recommendations for reranker/structured outputs + small playbook for 502s (Marissa) — due Mon 2027-06-06.
4) Concierge triage: if 5xx persists, escalate to eng and collect trace_id and request_dump (Jordan → Connor) — on call.

Hints/quick checks for your engineers:
- Auth: SDK requires Authorization: Bearer <key> header. If you're proxying through API gateway, ensure header is forwarded and not stripped.
- Routing: prefer us-west-2 region endpoints to avoid cross-region latency; set routing policy to prefer low-cost small models for candidate generation, then rerank with a higher-capacity model.
- Structured output/tool-calls: validate the JSON schema for tool_call in the request (extra top-level fields can trigger schema errors upstream).

I attached an architecture diagram (architecture_diagram.png) showing the proposed flow and where to collect traces.

Next step: Can you send a sample failing request_dump and the exact curl/SDK call that reproduces the 502? If you're able, include the full upstream trace id (trace_id) — that makes triage much faster.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime

From: Paul Chan <paul.chan@windward.tech>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: engineering@windward.tech
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Implementation plan and next steps (SDK, auth, routing, rerankers)

Jordan / team — thanks for the clear plan. We tried the flow this morning and hit intermittent 502s when calling your hosted endpoint via our gateway. Attaching a dump (request_dump.json). Excerpt of the error from our gateway logs below: 

[2027-05-31T08:58:43Z] upstream_read_error: received HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway from 44.33.22.11 for "POST /v1/chat"
trace_id=tr_0b9f3a7e
client_ip=52.11.77.9
request_latency_ms=312

Sample curl we used (sanitized):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-rerank-1","input":{"query":"find relevant sections","candidates":["doc1","doc2"]},"structured_call":{"name":"rerank","arguments":{}}}'

We also saw a JSON parse error once in the gateway when we had an additional top-level key client_context included by our SDK wrapper: 

{"error":"upstream: parse error at position 234 - unexpected key 'client_context'"}

Can you advise on immediate mitigations? We're blocked from running larger test batches.

-Paul
Paul Chan
Head of Platform Engineering | Windward Tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Chan <paul.chan@windward.tech>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Implementation plan and next steps (SDK, auth, routing, rerankers)

Paul — appreciate the dump and the snippet. Quick guidance while we triage: 

1) Header propagation: confirm your gateway preserves the Authorization header when proxying. A common misconfig is to rewrite or drop Authorization; that results in auth failures that surface as 502 in some gateway configs. Test: run the curl directly to our endpoint (we provided below) from a shell inside your network to rule out gateway changes.

Direct repro curl (hit our staging routing):
curl -v -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.inference/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TEST_KEY>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-rerank-1","input":{"query":"repro test","candidates":["doc1"]},"structured_call":{"name":"rerank","arguments":{}}}'

2) Client timeout: please bump your client timeout to 60s temporarily. The logs show ~300ms but gateway retries can amplify issues.

3) Schema strictness: we saw the parse error for 'client_context'. Don't add extra top-level keys to the request body. If you need to pass metadata, put it under input.metadata or headers.

4) Trace collection: If you hit a 502 again, send us the full HTTP interaction including request headers and the response body. The trace_id (tr_0b9f3a7e) is helpful — include it in the subject line of follow-up.

5) Embedding/re-ranker note: if your embedding vectors are sent as base64 blobs in a nested field, make sure the field name is embeddings.vec (we validate type/shape server-side). Mismatched shapes can cause internal handler errors (rare) and surface as 5xx.

I've added a short playbook to our Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/windward-implementation-pack (see '502-troubleshooting.md'). Also creating a JIRA for engineering triage: JIRA-3258.

If you can share the full request_dump.json from your test that triggered trace_id=tr_0b9f3a7e, we'll reproduce on our staging cluster and escalate.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Connor — forwarding Windward's dump and the notes. They saw trace_id=tr_0b9f3a7e and intermittent 502s. Can you pick this up for a repro on staging? Key points:
- Try their request_dump.json attached.
- Reproduce with both direct curl and via a small Node SDK wrapper that adds an extraneous top-level 'client_context' (to validate parse error path).
- Check our ingress logs around tr_0b9f3a7e for any internal JSON.decode exceptions and which subhandler threw.

Please update JIRA-3258 with reproducibility steps and ETA. If you need me to loop in infra for ingress throttling, say the word.

Thanks Ben — picking this up now. Plan for repro: 
1) Run direct curl against staging using Paul's sanitized payload.
2) Run Node SDK wrapper that injects client_context to validate parse failure path.
3) If we get 502, capture full ingress logs + worker logs + stack trace and the internal JSON.decode error (if present).
4) Try a run with a tweaked request where embeddings field uses 'embeddings.vec' shape to verify shape-mismatch path.

I'll create a short runbook in JIRA-3258 with commands and post back within 6 hours of starting. If we can't repro in that window, we'll schedule a joint debugging session with Windward engineers for live repro.

—Connor
